title: Stroll through Alcazar
text: We had a phenomenal time touring the Real Alcazar with Karlos. He was super descriptive of the history of the Alcazar and it’s Muslim and Roman influences throughout the 3 chambers within. We also got to enjoy the areas where GOT was filmed.
author: Sumeet_G

title: Beautiful visit to Sevilla’s Alcazar
text: Sara our guide, was extremely nice and informative, very knowledgeable. Gave us much more information than it was expected and it was a very pleasant experience. Would do it again without hesitation.
author: LUISS_N

title: Must see
text: This tour is a must - the palace is stunning - full of surprises.  Our guide Elana was fun and very knowledgeable.  Delighted with the day. I would highly recommend the his tour.
author: anne_m
